title: Terrorism on its last legs in J&K

ai.summary: The article discusses the decline in terrorism in Jammu and Kashmir, noting reduced terrorist recruitment and incidents, with police stating local terrorist recruitment had fallen to almost zero over two years, and only two Kashmiri youths joining Lashkar-e-Taiba in that period.
